{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Families formed or enlarged by adoption strengthen communities and ennoble the nation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Private entities which facilitate adoptions enrich communities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for measures such as the First Amendment Defense Act to ensure entities facilitating adoptions do not face government discrimination because of their views on marriage and family.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Appreciation for Republican initiatives that have led to an increase in adoptions, an achievement that should be recognized in any restructuring of the federal tax code.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The number of children in foster care has stabilized.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Teens who age out of foster care often are abruptly left to face the world on their own.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Urgence for states and community groups to help young adults aging out of foster care become independent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Reagan commissioned a Special Working Group on the Family to study how government at all levels could be more supportive of family life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Urgence for removal of marriage penalties from the tax code and public assistance programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Invitation for all who care about children to join a proposal to ensure that all federal programs stress the integrity and preservation of the family unit, in the words of President Kennedy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
